titlePattern: The page's own name, then “ · Dylan Castor”. The main home is the exception: the name first.

home.title: Dylan Castor · Shopify & CRO engineer
home.description: This site shows how I work on every layer, from what shoppers see to the servers underneath. Five floors, three paths.

agencies.title: White-label test builds for CRO agencies · Dylan Castor
agencies.description: You run the strategy and the client relationship. I build the tests. Your clients only see your agency.

brands.title: One developer for your whole store · Dylan Castor
brands.description: For Shopify brands that want one developer instead of an agency: tests, theme work, custom apps and the servers behind them.

floor1.title: Shopify & CRO · Dylan Castor
floor1.description: What your customers see: the tests, and the theme they run on.

flicker.title: Flicker-free A/B tests · Dylan Castor
flicker.description: Why a tested page can jump under the visitor’s eyes, and how to stop it. Work the lantern to see both.

checkTest.title: Checking a test before launch · Dylan Castor
checkTest.description: Six ways a test can be wrong before it goes live, and how I check each one. Open the six marks to see them.

legalEn.title: Legal notice · Dylan Castor
legalEn.description: Who publishes and hosts this site, and what happens to the messages sent through its forms.

legalFr.title: Mentions légales · Dylan Castor
legalFr.description: Qui publie et héberge ce site, et ce que deviennent les messages envoyés par ses formulaires.

formErrors.replyTo: Please check your email address: I need it to reply.
failed: The message did not go through. Nothing is lost: try again, or
formErrors.noScriptNote: Without script a form cannot send: it is hidden, and this line shows in its place, followed by the email address (decided 16 Nov 2026).
formErrors.failedNote: The middle part is the same email link as the one already under the form. The sentence is also the answer to a message refused by the invisible robot checks.

notes: Descriptions are each page's own first sentences, chosen by Dylan on 15 Nov 2026. If a page's first sentences change, its description changes with them.
The main home's description replaces the proposal that was in home.json (`descriptionStatus`).
The legal notice's two descriptions are new sentences.
